summary: Above Food Ingredients Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a July 17, 2026 press release regarding its appeal of Nasdaq's prior delisting determination. The Company engaged Dickinson Wright PLLC, led by Jacob Frenkel, to represent it before the Nasdaq Listing and Hearing Review Council. The delisting stems from a failure to file the Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, violating Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). The Company is pursuing the appeal while working to complete its overdue filings. Watch for the Listing Council's decision and the timing of filing remediation.
